prompt: Which of the following are personnel controls?

options.text: Job design and provision of necessary resources

explanation: Personnel controls build on employees' natural tendencies to control themselves: selection & placement, training, job design & resources. Codes of conduct are cultural controls.

prompt: Which of the following are instruments of cultural control?
explanation: All five are cultural controls: they shape shared norms and values and rely on mutual monitoring within the group.

prompt: According to Simons' Levers of Control, which levers are used to FRAME the strategic domain and inspire/limit search behaviour?
explanation: Belief systems (core values, inspire) and boundary systems (risks to avoid, limit) frame the strategic domain. Diagnostic and interactive systems deal with performance variables and strategic uncertainties.

prompt: Which statements describe INTERACTIVE control systems (Simons)?

options.text: Top management uses them to personally and regularly involve themselves in subordinates' decisions
They focus on strategic uncertainties and stimulate dialogue and learning
They are used to monitor critical performance variables by exception
They can trigger the emergence of new strategies

explanation: Interactive systems focus attention on strategic uncertainties, involve top management personally, and enable emergent strategy. Monitoring by exception describes diagnostic control systems.
